For iPhone 7, iPhone 7 Plus, and iPod touch: Press and hold the Top (or Side) and Volume Down buttons at the same time. Keep holding the buttons till you get the Recovery Mode screen.

Firstly, you will receive a confirmation email in your Apple ID email inbox.
